## IPinotRetryOptions.backoffFactor property

Exponential backoff factor applied to `retryDelayMs` per attempt. Delay for attempt `n` = `retryDelayMs * backoffFactor ^ (n - 1)`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
backoffFactor?: number;
```

## Default Value

2
